sections.content: Combine identity, migration, adaptation, belonging and relative clauses to discuss having more than one cultural identity.

items.spanish: Tengo dos identidades que forman parte de mi vida.
items.english: I have two identities that are part of my life.

items.spanish: He aprendido a integrar diferentes partes de mi experiencia.
items.english: I have learned to integrate different parts of my experience.

items.spanish: Puedo mantener mis tradiciones y adaptarme a un nuevo lugar.
items.english: I can maintain my traditions and adapt to a new place.

sections.content: A nuanced discussion can describe both continuity and change without treating identity as fixed.
